query:
SELECT title, startTime, endTime, DATE_FORMAT(blockedDate, '%Y-%m-%d') as date
FROM blocked_times
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(blockedDate, '%Y-%m-%d') = '2026-03-18'
ORDER BY startTime;
